disposition.P05-A01: The existing simulated acceptance is supported within the declared plain-Python copying contract.

limitations: This is read-only evidence/claim reconciliation and independent review, not new native execution, a full-suite rerun or a rerun of the three auditors.
Qualified installed execution remains Linux x86_64 GIL CPython 3.12.14, RV64 SimX, six declared packed FP16/BF16 matmul signatures and ten frozen model cases.

No PyTorch route/version, complete framework backend, unsupported gradients, training, arbitrary models/weights, zero-copy, concurrency, CUDA compatibility, Python RTL/XRT, physical FPGA/silicon or performance claim is accepted.

Hashes and reviewed command observations establish trusted-builder consistency. They do not authenticate binary authorship, reproduce all transitive builds, provide hostile-filesystem isolation, or establish arbitrary-host wheel portability.
Publication freshness, final mutable compatibility documentation and the complete agent ledger are separate final-wave obligations.
The reviewer preliminary schema-inspection KeyError is retained separately; it occurred before reconciliation and changed no product, auditor or evidence input.

phase_and_authorization_boundary.inherited_DSP_267_to_283_finding: preserved; not closed by this review

review_observations.observation: The acceptance references actual installed SimX commands and source-matched host tests. Numerical references use frozen upstream fixtures and a hash-pinned independent P04 helper; the final acceptance record is not used as its own numerical or command-success oracle.

The 14 passing command entries match retained zero exits and exact argument strings. The aggregate wrapper failure remains separate from the three successful auditor exits; the independent full/selected and relocated comparisons agree.

Native packet copies are not counted again. Raw traces independently yield 72 Python and 72 native launches, with 360 and 300 profile pairs respectively; native standalone observations are unprofiled.

The clean 2174-test hosted suite is tied to e1420fd. The earlier dirty 2163-test failure, baseline configure timeout and inherited workload-start assertion are retained; no unobserved cause or waiver is asserted.

Host fake-runtime failure injection is explicitly distinct from normal installed SimX execution; modeled recovery and status-publication MemoryError are not presented as hardware-fault recovery or global CPython OOM proof.

Hosted G++ 11.4 / CPython 3.12.14 and local G++ 14.2 evidence remain separately scoped. RUNPATH, external system libraries, copied representations, explicit close and potentially unbounded destruction remain limitations.

scope: Independent final technical review of the bounded P05-A01 acceptance and its retained proof. This review does not execute native code, rerun the auditors or tests, grant a waiver, publish a commit or change the existing acceptance decision.
